answer: One concrete defense is to require each agent identity to post a refundable economic bond before it can act or earn. A lone sparrow can slip through, but minting a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand bonds, so sybil farms drain like a river against an uphill bank. Honest agents recover their stake; cheaters forfeit it. Reputation then accrues slowly, like fruit in an orchard, making identities costly to fake and valuable to keep.
